transcript.en: Good morning.
transcript.zh: 早上好

transcript.en: I'm very pleased to have been invited along to your club to talk about our Charity Sponsored Walking Holiday for Education Aid.
transcript.zh: 我很高兴被邀请到你们的俱乐部介绍我们的慈善徒步旅行为教育援助赞助的活动。

transcript.en: I'll start by giving you a brief overview of what it entails .
transcript.zh: 我先给大家介绍一下这次活动的内容。

transcript.en: First of all let me explain what we mean by sponsored here.
transcript.zh: 首先，我先解释一下“赞助”在这里的意思。

transcript.en: This is where people promise to donate money to the charity if you achieve your goal,
transcript.zh: 如果你完成了目标，人们就会捐钱给慈善机构。

transcript.en: in this case to walk a certain number of miles.
transcript.zh: 步行到一定的公里数，

transcript.en: Basically we are organizing a ten—day holiday, from the sixth to the sixteenth of November,
transcript.zh: 基本上，我们组织了一个十天的假期，从11月6日至16日

transcript.en: with eight days actual walking trekking in the Semira Mountains.
transcript.zh: 其中有8天在Semira山脉爬山。

transcript.en: Let's have a look at some of the details.
transcript.zh: 让我们看看详细的情况。

transcript.en: We require you to raise sponsorship money of at least $3,200.
transcript.zh: 我们要求你们筹集至少3200美元的资助款

transcript.en: Paying $250 of it up front as a deposit and the rest in stages throughout the year.
transcript.zh: 其中先预付250美元作为押金，其余在全年分阶段付清。

transcript.en: Out of this about thirty-five per cent will go on your expenses, and that leaves sixty-five per cent guaranteed to go to the charity.
transcript.zh: 其中35％是你们的花费，剩余的65％保证给慈善机构。

transcript.en: Which brings me to the most important part.
transcript.zh: 下面是最重要的部分。

transcript.en: This trek is being specifically organized to help Education in the Semira region.
transcript.zh: 组织这次徒步旅行主要是为了帮助Semira地区的教育。

transcript.en: Last year we helped train teachers for the disabled and this year we're focusing on the pupils.
transcript.zh: 去年，我们为残疾人培训老师，今年我们将重点放在学生身上。

transcript.en: Each of the walkers' sponsorship money will go to help an individual special needs pupil in one of the mountain schools.
transcript.zh: 每个参与这次步行活动的人获得的资助款都将用于帮助一个来自山区学校有特殊需要的学生。

transcript.en: In the second part of the talk I'll be giving you a lot more details, but back to the basic information.
transcript.zh: 在第二部分，我会告诉你更多详情，但是回到基础信息上，

transcript.en: Age limits. This is the second time we have run this kind of holiday and um on the first we even had an eighty-year old, but we found it was wise to establish limits this time.
transcript.zh: 年龄限制。这是我们第二次搞这种假期，第一次我们甚至有80岁高龄的人参加，但是我们发现这次设置限制是明智的。

transcript.en: You have to be at least eighteen and the top limit is now seventy, though you need to obtain a health certificate from your doctor if you are over sixty years old.
transcript.zh: 你必须是18岁以上至70岁以下。如果你超过60岁，就得提供医生开的健康证明。

transcript.en: Now, the Semira Mountains are among the highest in the world but you mustn't be too daunted we will mainly be trekking in the foothills only, although there will be spectacular views even in the foothills .
transcript.zh: Semira山是世界上最高的山脉之一，但是大家不用害怕，我们只是在山脉的丘陵地带徒步旅行，这一地带的景色也很壮观。

transcript.en: However, you will need to be extremely fit if you aren't now and you're interested in coming with us.
transcript.zh: 然而，如果你现在身体不佳又很想跟我们去的话，你得变得非常健康才行。

transcript.en: You have plenty of time to get into shape.
transcript.zh: 你们有足够的时间调养身体。

transcript.en: You will be sleeping in tents so you must have quite a bit of equipment with you but you will be helped by local assistants.
transcript.zh: 你将睡在帐篷里，所以你得带一些装备，但是当地的助理会帮助你。

transcript.en: Your bedding and so forth will be carried by them.
transcript.zh: 他们会帮你拿着被褥之类的东西。

transcript.en: We ask that you only walk with a small rucksack with needs for the day.
transcript.zh: 我们要求你们在徒步旅行时只背小型背包。

transcript.en: I don't think I've really said enough about the marvellous area you'll be walking in.
transcript.zh: 关于途径的景色真是美不胜收，说之不尽。

transcript.en: Let's have a look at some of the sights you'll be seeing.
transcript.zh: 让我们看看你将看到的一些景色。

transcript.en: Apart from these spectacular snow-covered peaks and valleys, there are marvellous historic villages.
transcript.zh: 除了壮观的雪山峰顶和山谷，这里还有很多美丽的古老村庄。

transcript.en: The area has been famous for centuries for making beautiful carpets, although recently there has been a trend to move into weaving blankets and wood carving.
transcript.zh: 这里因制作精美的地毯而闻名几个世纪，尽管最近有转向编织毯和木雕的趋势。

transcript.en: The people are extremely friendly and welcoming.
transcript.zh: 这里的人非常友好、好客。

transcript.en: We deliberately keep the parties small in size to minimize disruption to people and landscape.
transcript.zh: 我们特意将活动人数减到最少，减低对这里的居民和风景的破坏。

transcript.en: I hope that there are still some people interested.
transcript.zh: 我希望还有一些人对此感兴趣。

transcript.en: I will be distributing leaflets at the end where you can find out more information,
transcript.zh: 我会在最后发宣传单，你们可以看到更多的信息，

transcript.en: but just for the moment I'll outline the itinerary, the main highpoints of the holiday.
transcript.zh: 但是现在我将概述一下这次假期的主要行程。

transcript.en: Obviously, you'll start by flying out to Kishba, the capital city, on Day One.
transcript.zh: 显然，第一天你们将飞往首都Kishba。

transcript.en: After a couple of days to acclimatize yourself, you'll start the trek on Day Three walking through the enormous Katiba Forest which will take the whole of the day.
transcript.zh: 经过几天的水土适应，你们将在第三天开始穿过广阔的Katiba森林，这要花一整天的时间。

transcript.en: Day Four takes us higher up going through the foothills past a number of villages and visiting a school for the disabled in Sohan.
transcript.zh: 第四天我们将往更高的地方走，经过丘陵地带穿过一些村庄，拜访在索汉的一所残障学校。

transcript.en: Then you have a rest day, that's Day Five,
transcript.zh: 第五天是休息时间。

transcript.en: before going to the spectacular Kumi Temple with twelfth-century carvings, set in a small forest by a lake and that's Day Six, the highlight for many.
transcript.zh: 最精彩的是第六天参观壮观的Kumi寺庙和12世纪的雕刻品，寺庙坐落在沿湖的小森林里。

transcript.en: We stay near there for Day Seven because then comes the hardest day, walking through very mountainous country, but culminating in a swim in the Parteh Falls.
transcript.zh: 第七天我们还在附近，因为之后是最艰难的一天，我们将穿过多山的乡村，抵达最后的parte瀑布游泳。

transcript.en: This is the highest waterfall in the region.
transcript.zh: 它这里最高的瀑布。

transcript.en: Day Nine is much easier, with part of the day spent in a village where they make some of the gorgeous red blankets.
transcript.zh: 第九天会轻松很多，我们会花部分时间游览制作精美红毯的村庄。

transcript.en: Then back down to Kishba and the journey home.
transcript.zh: 之后回到Kishba，返回家乡。

transcript.en: So you can see it's a pretty packed timetable…
transcript.zh: 所以你可以看到时间表塞的满满的
